transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: I want my teeth whiter for my wedding photos in May.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Sure. Your enamel is healthy and there are no fillings on the front teeth that would show.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let's take impressions for take-home whitening trays.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Wear them an hour a day for two weeks.
